name: reright
description: Hosted MCP server that rewrites text an agent drafted for people (emails, messages, posts, commit and PR text) so it reads human-written, with optional human approval before the agent uses it. rewrite sends the draft text to reright.it and counts against the account's monthly words; rewrite_result and keep_original only act on drafts the agent already sent. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Leave the server off and use the agent's draft as written; no text leaves the machine.
Use rewrite_result to read the state of a draft already sent, and keep_original to turn down a rewrite; neither sends new text.
